symptoms: Small, water-soaked lesions on lower leaves turning into brown or reddish-brown polygonal pustules primarily on abaxial leaf surface; rapid premature defoliation under high humidity.
favorable_conditions: Temperatures 18-28°C with leaf wetness > 6 hours and relative humidity > 80%.
biological_control: Foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L or Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L at first disease onset; spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE).
chemical_control: Hexaconazole 5% EC @ 2.0 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/L (CIBRC statutory dosage; PHI: 30 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Oilseeds)

symptoms: Angular, water-soaked lesions bounded by veinlets on leaves, progressing to black arm on petioles and water-soaked round spots on developing bolls.
favorable_conditions: Warm, humid weather with temperatures 28-35°C and continuous rainfall or overhead sprinkler irrigation.
biological_control: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed; foliar spray of P. fluorescens @ 2 g/L at 30, 60 and 90 DAS.
chemical_control: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L (CIBRC approved combination; PHI: 15 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Fibre Crops)

symptoms: Small, sunken whitish flecks with purple centers enlarging into concentric rings; leaves break at lesion points, causing bulb yield and quality loss.
favorable_conditions: Warm, moist weather (25-30°C) with prolonged relative humidity > 85% and frequent rainfall or heavy dew.
biological_control: Foliar application of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L or Bacillus subtilis @ 5 g/L; crop rotation with non-allium crops.
chemical_control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/L with sticker (CIBRC statutory dosage; PHI: 15 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Horticultural Diseases: Vegetables)

symptoms: Spindle-shaped (eye-shaped) lesions with ash-colored centers and dark brown borders on leaves; neck rot causes panicle to droop and break with chaffy grains.
favorable_conditions: Low night temperatures (20-24°C), high relative humidity (>90%), morning dew, and excessive nitrogenous fertilizer application.
biological_control: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg followed by seedling dip @ 2.5 kg/ha in 100 L water; foliar spray @ 2 g/L at boot stage.
chemical_control: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L (CIBRC statutory recommendation; PHI: 30 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Cereals)

symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green to tan lesions up to 15 cm long on leaves, causing extensive blighting of canopy and poor grain filling.
favorable_conditions: Moderate temperatures (20-27°C) with prolonged cloudiness and high humidity during vegetative growth.
biological_control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed; foliar spray of Trichoderma @ 5 g/L upon first lower leaf spot appearance.
chemical_control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1.0 ml/L (CIBRC approved; PHI: 21 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Cereals)

symptoms: Circular to irregular dark brown necrotic spots with prominent yellow halos on upper surface; late leaf spot lesions are darker without yellow halos; leads to complete defoliation.
favorable_conditions: Prolonged warm and wet conditions (25-30°C) with high humidity (>80%) and rain splashing.
biological_control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4 g/kg seed; foliar spray of 5% Neem oil emulsion or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L at 40 and 60 DAS.
chemical_control: Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.0 ml/L (CIBRC statutory dosage; PHI: 21 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Oilseeds)

symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery pustules (uredinia) arranged in distinct parallel stripes along leaf veins; infected leaves dry up and test weight drops drastically.
favorable_conditions: Cool, humid weather (10-18°C) with intermittent winter rains or heavy morning fog.
biological_control: Grow resistant varieties (e.g. HD-2967, PBW-550); balanced nitrogen fertilization avoiding excessive urea.
chemical_control: Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1.0 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25% WG @ 1.0 g/L (CIBRC statutory dosage; PHI: 30 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Cereals)

symptoms: Third or fourth leaf from top shows yellowing and withering; internal split cane reveals blood-red discolored pith with diagnostic transverse white patches and alcohol odor.
favorable_conditions: Waterlogged soil conditions, temperatures 25-32°C, and continuous cultivation of susceptible cultivars.
biological_control: Sett treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L water for 15 minutes before planting; soil application of Trichoderma with enriched FYM @ 2.5 kg/ha.
chemical_control: Sett dipping in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1.0 g/L for 15 minutes before planting; remove and burn affected clumps.
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Crop Diseases: Sugar Crops)

symptoms: Dark brown to black target-board circular spots with concentric rings on older leaves; yellowing halos around lesions; dark sunken lesions at stem base and calyx end.
favorable_conditions: Warm, humid weather (24-29°C) with alternating wet and dry periods.
biological_control: Foliar application of Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L or Trichoderma asperellum @ 5 g/L at 15-day intervals; mulching to prevent soil splashing.
chemical_control: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L (CIBRC approved; PHI: 7 days).
source_authority: TNAU Agritech Portal — Crop Protection (Horticultural Diseases: Vegetables)
